title: AS2 class declarations: class/extends/super/this compiler support
description: The AS2 compiler (packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts) handles functions and basic statements but not class declarations. Add Flash 8 AS2 class support: (1) class Foo { } — compiles to a constructor function + prototype assignments; (2) class Foo extends Bar { } — sets up prototype chain (Foo.prototype = new Bar()); (3) method declarations compile to Foo.prototype.methodName = function(...) { ... }; (4) this keyword in instance methods refers to the object; (5) super() call in constructor chains to parent constructor; (6) static method declarations (static function foo(){}) compile to Foo.foo = function(){...}; (7) public/private keywords are parsed but ignored (AS2 doesn't enforce them at runtime). The compiler should emit AVM1 bytecode sequences for all of the above. Add tests in packages/core/src/as2/__tests__/classes.test.ts covering each case. Only touches packages/core/src/as2/ — no authoring-ui changes.
